segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: On behalf of the Department of Labor and Employment, I thank this committee for the opportunity to present for the first time the Department's proposed budget for fiscal year 2027.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: For 2027, the Department remains focused on delivering outcomes that matters most to Filipino workers.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: More and better employment opportunities, a future-ready workforce, stronger protection of workers' rights and welfare, strengthened social protection, accessible labor justice, and sustained industrial peace.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: At the heart of this direction is Trabajo Agad, creating more employment opportunities and delivering faster and more accessible services.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Through future-ready manggagawa, we will equip Filipino workers with the skills and resilience to adapt to a rapidly changing world of work.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: At the same time, we will strengthen worker protection, social protection, program, labor justice, industrial peace, supported by a mas matatag na dole that is responsive, accountable, digitally enabled, and committed to a better and faster public service.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: For the fiscal year 2027, under the National Expenditure Program, the Department of Labor and Employment has been allocated a total of 47.057 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: With this proposed budget, Dole commits to ensuring that every peso entrusted to the Department delivers concrete and meaningful results for Filipino workers and their families.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: With the support of this Honorable Committee,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: we will translate our priorities and resources into responsive programs, measurable results,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: better employment opportunities, stronger worker protection, and more accessible services.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: More than the spending plan, the fiscal year 2027 budget is our commitment to deliver and

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: to be accountable to the Filipino people for the results we promised.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Mahal na Komite, kung inyo pong papahintulutan, ay amin pong gustong ilahad through a detailed

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino

segments.text: Na kinikilala nyo ang posisyon ng gobyerno, no bond, no injunction.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Therefore, yung dagdag sahod ng mga minimum wage earner ay dapat ipatupad at ibigay na since July 25.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, Your Honor, members of this committee,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: ang kagawaran po ng empleyo ay naniniwala na ang paglilift ng injunction is not a matter of self-help.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Naniniwala po tayo sa mga inilabas na desisyon ng Korte Suprema.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Kabilang na po ang LCK versus Pagbilao Development Corporation,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: I mean us, not just the executive branch,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: against treating a bond defect, including the non-filing thereof,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: not as an automatic license to disregard injunctive relief.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Failure to fix a bond or post a bond did not itself justify quashing the injunction.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: And, Your Honor, there is another case, Development Bank of the Philippines versus Carpio, GR 147-191,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: where the Supreme Court mentioned that there is no such thing as a doctrine of unilateral disregard.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Ang ibig pong sabihin, Your Honor,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: If there is a facial court restraint which is outstanding,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: the affected party should obtain a judicial declaration of that consequence

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: rather than conclusively deciding the matter for itself.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Ang ibig pong sabihin, Mr. Chairman, Your Honors, with all due respect,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Hindi po ang dole, hindi po ang litigants.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Ang magdi-desisyon kung mali ang proseso.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Ang magdi-desisyon po nito ay ang husgado.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Sila po lang ang may puder, courts, have the discretion over the bond and the integrity of a bond,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: and that does not automatically void any previous injunction,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: and the objecting party must challenge it, and the court must correct it.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: That's why, Your Honor, we filed this, September 3,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: ang abugado po namin ay Office of the Solicitor General, motion to resolve.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Sa ngayon, kung ano po yung inyong nararamdaman, yun din po yung aming nararamdaman.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: But, again, I raise this principle, and members of the bar here present would agree with me,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: that the doctrine of self-help is applicable in a very narrow or limited situations.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: nung katadaan lang pong habagat, Your Honor, marami nakikinig ngayon,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: applicable po yung doktrina sa Civil Code of the Philippines, Article 429,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: na kung mababa yung lugar mo, yung kapitbahay mo yung mas mataas,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: pwede mong ilipat yung gamit doon sa mataas ng lugar na kahit walang court order, yung po yung self-help.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Sa criminal case, meron po tayo sa rules of court.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: If a crime is being committed,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Subalit, Your Honor, there is no comparable doctrine, general doctrine,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: authorizing a litigant or a government agency, including the DOLE,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: to substitute its own judgment for that of a court,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: and unilaterally treat a judicial injunction as nonexistent,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: merely because it believes, as I believe,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: that the bond requirement has not been satisfied.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Therefore, the wage order is in effect.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ibig sabihin, the wage order is in effect.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: There is an injunction insofar as the writ is concerned.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Mr. Chair, malinaw po ang nakasulat sa order ni RTC Branch 152,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Let a preliminary injunction be issued upon...

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Posting a bond of 10 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Kung atin pong bubusisiin yung kasaysayan nito,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: nagsimula po ito sa status ko ante order.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: That was issued by the executive branch judge of Pasig RTC.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: That was July 24, a day before the implementation.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Ang kasunod po nun, kasi maglalapse yung Temporary Restraining Order,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: ito na nga pong writ of preliminary injunction.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: So there would be two documents visually in front of me right now.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: The order of injunction as well as the writ which requires, as a condition precedent,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: the payment of the 10 billion bond.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: starting from the status quo order,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: you have a facially substantial order coming from the court,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: which the court has the sole right to lift, correct, or dissolve.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: That's why we filed a motion to resolve.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: hindi po ang DOLE ang magde-decide kung na-dissolve na yung bond.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Under the threat of contempt pursuant to Rule 71,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: eh hindi po karapatan namin na mag-decide.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Isimplihan ko na lang po siguro po ito.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Meron po akong halimbawa na tickets sa dalawang airline companies,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: na inamin naman nila na hindi na-issued.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Hindi naman po ako pwedeng pumunta na lang doon sa airport at dumiretso sa aeroplano.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: There is a process for this.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: I should be given, recognized by the airline manager,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: I should be given a boarding pass.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: In a similar manner, kung yung ating mga senior citizen ay nagkamali yung binigay na gamot ng mercury drug,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: eh hindi naman basta pwedeng pumasok si lola o yung nanay ko sa bodega ng mercury drug para kunin yung tamang gamot.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Ganon din po dito. Lalong-lalong na po ito.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Ay hukuman. Pero lahat po ng sinasabi niyo ay nararamdaman ko po iyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Mr. Secretary, so in simple words, hindi ipapatupad ng Department of Labor and Employment yung dagdag ng sahot?

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Ipapatupad po namin. Ganito po yun. Ayun, napataas na naman yung boses ko.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Kayo po yun nag-file, at sinusuportahan ko kayo, kayo po yun nag-file ng certiorary sa Supreme Court.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Para ang Regional Trial Court ay kumilos.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Nagpa sa ilalim po ang mga grupo ninyo at lahat ng manggagawa.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: At tayo po ay sumusuporta dyan, including current petitions for intervention na makasali kayo sa usgado.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Nung nag-file po kayo ng petisyon sa Supreme Court, ang ibig sabihin po, kinikilala rin nyo rin po yung hurisdiksyon, mawalanggalang na, with all due respect,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: ng hindi lang ng kataas-taas ang hukuman.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Kung hindi ng Regional Trial Court tumpasig. Dahil sinasabing nyo sa Supreme Court, orderan nyo ang RTC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Mr. Chair, ang argument nga po namin walang jurisdiksyon in the first place ang RTC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: That is why pumunta na kami sa Supreme Court para magbigay ng kalinawan ang mataas na hukuman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Dahil hindi namin kinikilala ang jurisdiksyon ng Regional Trial Court as already enshrined in the Labor Code, Article 126,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: now being the Secretary of Labor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: board and employment, Mr. Secretary, Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: dapat nga hindi nyo kinilalay yung jurisdiction ng korte

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: because it is very clear in Article 126.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ang appeal process kung merong aggrieved party sa Article 123,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: binabanggit sa National Wages and Productivity Commission.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So, ang binabanggit ng DOLE ngayon, pagkahaba-haba po nang ine-explain ninyo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: at the end of it all, sinasabi nyo, hindi nyo ipapatupad yung dagdag sahod.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Wala po akong sinabing gano'n po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: O di, ipapatupad nyo po yung dagdag sahod.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Ito po ay nakasalalay sa decision of the government.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Kahit po lumabas po ito sa social media.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Yes. Meron po kayong kapangyarihan, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Iginawad ng kongreso yan sa inyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: RA 6727, ibinigay sa mga regional wage boards

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: ang exclusive power in determining wages.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ngayon sinasabi po, DOLE mismo ang nagbabanggit,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ipatutupad ng DOLE, sang-ayon sa nakasulat sa batas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Kung kakasuhan kayo, Mr. Secretary, nandyan ang OSG.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ang inihingi po ng mga minimum wage earners at ng mga manggagawa,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: tindigan nyo naman yung karapatan ng mga minimum wage earners.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Hindi po namin marinig sa inyo eh.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Alam nyo po, Mr. Chairman, hinahangaan ko po kayo sa sinasabi nyo yan.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Subalit, kung titignan natin yung Article 126,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: when it refers to a prohibition on injunction,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Kaya nga po, sa pagmamahal ko po sa inyong samahan

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: at sa mga manggagawa na rin,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: tayo po ay nag-issue ng Administrative Order 264

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: kung saan po natin niliwanag, pinaliwanag, pinalawak,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: binigyan ng ilaw kung ano ang tamang ibig sabihin ng 126

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: At yan din po ang dahilan kung bakit yung dati kong colleague

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: sa mataas na kapulungan, si Sen. Rafi Tulfo,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: ay nag-file ng amendatory bill sa Senado

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: kung paano dapat maintindihan o mapalawak ang Article 126.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: So ang ginawa po natin sa Administrative Order No. 264

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: ay palawakin ang ibig sabihin ng proceedings, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Palawakin ang ibig sabihin ng proceedings to include

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: execution, and ensuring that wage orders are complied with.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Yung po siguro ang isang sinyales na pinaninindigan po natin

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: kahit po nung pagpa-file natin ng motion for reconsideration

segments.text: na basang-basa na po tayo ng ulan sa Lunsod ng Pasig at Bumabaha

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: At para sa kalaman po nga ng kagalanggalang

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: na mga kasama dito sa lupung ito,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: kung kakausapin nyo ang Office of the Solicitor General,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: tayo po ang nagsulong, nag-udyok, at naghikayat

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: na sila ang mag-file ng motion for early resolution.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Lahat po ng aking hakbang, Your Honors,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: nanumpa po ako na puprotektahan ang batas,

segments.text: hindi lamang asaligang batas ng Pilipinas.

segments.text: that I do not subscribe to the doctrine of self-help.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Hindi po natin dapat hawakan sa sarili nating kamay

segments.text: Gusto man natin o hindi na ito ang tamang ipatupad.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: We cannot be an arbiter of our own cause or controversies.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Dapat po sana maunawaan ng lupung ito

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: na ang ating ginagawa ay paggalang sa batas.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Tama po yung inyong sinasabi, naniniwala po ako,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: tama rin po yung sinabi ng kung sino yung Supreme Court spokesperson kahapon,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: na kung walang bond, walang writ.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Subalit, ang dapat magsabi po nito ay hindi ako,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: kung hindi ang Supreme Court o ang husgado.

segments.text: At naniliwala rin po ako na karapatan ng manggagawang Pilipino

segments.text: na makatanggap na sila ng karapat dapat na umento

segments.text: Na ng presyo ng bilihin, kuryente, at iba pa.

segments.text: If that is your position, Mr. Chair, Mr. Sekretary,

segments.text: bakit hindi nyo po masabi na ipapatupad na ng dole?

segments.text: Paikot-ikot lang po tayo dito, Mr. Chair, Mr. Sekretary.

segments.text: Sinasabi nyo po, galangin yung batas.

segments.text: E batas din naman po ang nagsasabi na kapangyarihan nyo

segments.text: yung magpatupad at magtakda ng sahod.

segments.text: So, bakit hindi po namin makuha mula sa inyo, Mr. Sekretary?

segments.text: Pasabihin nyo po yung paulit-ulit na naman,

segments.text: paikot-ikot na naman tayo sa batas.

segments.text: Pero batas din ang nagsasabi, iginawad nga sa inyo.

segments.text: Ngayon po, pwede po akong sumagot.

segments.text: Dati po kasi sa Senado, hindi rin ako nakatingin dyan.

segments.text: Hindi ko po nakita yung oras. Sorry po.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Kung ano man po ang itinatakda ng batas,

segments.text: at magtatakda kung ano ang tamang interpretasyon

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: at hindi po ang mga abugado.

segments.text: Tayo po ay miyembro ng bar

segments.text: ipatupad nyo mamaya, ipapatupad na po natin mamaya.

segments.text: Tayo po ay nagpa-sa-ilalim sa batas

segments.text: sa husgado. Kagaya na rin po

segments.text: ng ginawa nyo, nung kayo ay nag-file

segments.text: kung ano man po ang kalalabasan

segments.text: Pero ang mga minimum wage earner na araw-araw

segments.text: maliit man sa pandinig natin, malaking bagay

segments.text: yan sa buhay ng mga minimum wage earner.

segments.text: Yan po yung dahilan kung bakit

segments.text: mismo natin sa dole, hindi nyo

segments.text: pero hindi nyo kayang ipagtanggol man lang

segments.text: wala po kayong karapatan na humingi ng budget

segments.text: the Secretary is just telling us

segments.text: Unang-una po, wala pa pong nag-second

segments.text: but because we are aware that we were flagged by the International Labor Organization likewise.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: The administration of NEA is now actively pursuing a tripartite system likewise within the sector.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: We understood, we took note of their concerns.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Ang sinasabi po nila, meron daw po mga ilang electric cooperatives na talagang malaki ang kinikita.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Meron namang electric cooperatives na yung management took advantage pretending themselves to be part of the employees group

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: na nakikinabang din pag merong dinidistribute.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: So, meron po nga yung ongoing technical working group between DOLE and NEA para maresolba po ito.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Meron lang kaunting usapin na ayaw ibigay ng NEA yung kanilang quote-unquote regulatory...

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: powers kung functions na madidilute kung sakaling pumasok sila sa ganitong kasunduan.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: So, yung ganun pong aspeto ay ang aming pinag-uusapan ngayon.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: It will take some time, but I think we're on the right path na mariresolba po ito.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: May commitment po si NEA Administrator Almeda patungkol po dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Mr. Chair, Mr. Secretary, gusto ko lang pong balaan kayo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Almeda, isang taon pa pong nangako sa amin dito sa Kongreso.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Pero hanggang ngayon po, hindi pa rin sinususpindi itong policy that allows the NEA to interfere

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: in the CBA of our workers' unions in this cooperative.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: So, ang pakiusap po namin, while waiting for the tripartite policy,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: baka pwede po magbigay ng issuean sa DOLE para sa ganun po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Pigilan po ito pong hindi po legal na prosesong ito ng pagharang sa CBA ng ating mga frontliners

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: pwede ting sa electric co-op industry.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. I'd like to proceed to...

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: September 29 po yung susunod na pagpupulong namin ng NEA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: September 29, sana po, even before that, baka pwede na po may issueans

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: to the effect na sinuspinde po natin at nirescind yung current policy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Kasi po, kung mag-on-going pa po yung ating negotiations and dialogues,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: it will take time bago po fully ma-rescind itong polisiyang ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sana po, for the here and now, baka po pwedeng mahilingan ng isang issuance ang DOLE,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: to allow our unions to proceed with their CBA without the interference of the NEA administration.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Pwede po akong makiusap, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Pwede po kaya sa September 29 ay magpadala kayo ng isang kinatawan

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: para makaharap din at maging bahagi ng usapin between DOLE and NEA?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Ang Power Centro po ay ipapadala natin sa natural dialogue na yan

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: para po talaga marinig po ninyo ng diretsyo yung concerns sa ating workers in the power industry.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Let me go to our colleague from the TESDA, Secretary Benitez.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sinabi po ng DTI noong nakaraang budget hearing po nila

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: that they are shifting their industrial policy from automotive towards electric vehicles.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Ang tanong po ng Philippine Metal Workers Alliance ay

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: may we ask if TESDA has ongoing plans to design TVET programs

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: catered towards the electric vehicle industry?

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: We, Mr. Chair, we already have competency

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: standards and training regulations for EV, for electric vehicles po.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Ongoing po ang rollout ng training for EV in the energy sector.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: I can submit to your officer the list of all the electric vehicle trainings

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: that actually TESDA already has, including for two-wheel, three-wheel,

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: hanggang four-wheel po at trucks and buses.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Meron pong training regulations ang TESDA.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Some of these were developed in partnerships po

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: with foreign companies, particularly from China

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: that is in advance in terms of having training modules.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: So meron po to answer very succinctly.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: At ibigay nyo na rin po sa amin kung saan pong areas

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: pwede maka-avail ng scholarship ang ating mga kababayan

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: para po makapasok sa industriyang ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Let me move on to my last point.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: May ipinabot pong concern ang mga kasama natin

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: mula sa National Union of Building and Construction Workers

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Nabinbin daw po ang Construction Workers Training Program

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: The interruption of the 2026 cycle could deprive up to 300 workers

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Ang mabilis pong tanong, bakit hindi natuloy ang training na ito

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: and is DOLE considering the resumption of this very critical training program anytime soon?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: That would be my last question, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Sir, this is actually part of an agreement with the DPWH in Daga

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: and the funds are still with DPWH po.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: So we have not been able to receive the funds in order to conduct the training

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: for the displaced construction workers from DPWH projects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: So when do we plan to resum this program?

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: We are waiting, sir, for the transfer of funds.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: We are waiting for the transfer of funds from the DPWH for this purpose.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: So we'll keep on following up, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: Thank you very much, Rep. Percy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: Next, from the majority, Deputy Speaker Raymond Mendoza.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: Mr. Secretary, welcome to your first budget hearing.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: And good morning to all the officials of DOLE,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: Mr. Secretary, first I would like to thank you. Galing po ako sa TUCP, a 50-year-old organization,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: through the help of the DFA and, of course, Point of Affairs.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: And, of course, through your office, the ASEAN,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: which the ASEAN Trade Union Council based in Jakarta,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: wherein I am a General Secretary, we sent a delegate.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: And we'd like to thank the efforts of Ame Tor,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: And we were able to be recognized.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: It's very historic for the ASEAN labor movement.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: And, of course, of the International Trade Union Congress,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: which is based also in Bangkok.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: Second, well, we have, of course, to R.D.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: And, uh, ano yung saan ba si R.D.?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: Of course, in relation to the wage order,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: First lang, yung sa voluntary arbitrators,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: The VA, I wish na dapat tagdagan mo yung budget.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: Education alone accounts only for P355,000.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: You know naman the budget of Tupad.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: So, Mr. Secretary, kindly comment on their commitment and your support

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: for the increase of budget for the voluntary arbitrators,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: again, in which I'm a founding member.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Dagang salamat sa tanong na yan.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: At siguro po, mamaya padadagdagan ko ng detalya sa NCMB

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: yung patungkol sa mga voluntary arbitrators.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Pero kasama niyo po ako doon sa...

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: kasi ang dami pong weather disruptions

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: ng isang maritime labor affairs office

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: na nakatutok lang po sa mga karapatan

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: nakatutok po tayo dyan. Wala pong isang linggo

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Pero gusto kong padagdagan ng detalye

segments.speaker: NCMB OIC-Executive Director IV Teresita E. Audea
NCMB OIC-Executive Director IV Teresita E. Audea
segments.text: At with the permission of the Secretary, yung pong pondo ng voluntary arbitrators ay nakasama po at nakapaloob sa MOOE ng NCMB.

segments.speaker: NCMB OIC-Executive Director IV Teresita E. Audea
segments.text: So yung pong sinasabi ni Honorable Speaker, Deputy Speaker Mendoza, ay isang malaking bagay kung madadagdagan po yung pondo na yun.

segments.speaker: NCMB OIC-Executive Director IV Teresita E. Audea
segments.text: Ang training component po ng aming budget ay kinukuha para sa mga arbitrators po ay kinukuha sa CBA collection.

segments.speaker: NCMB OIC-Executive Director IV Teresita E. Audea
segments.text: So doon po namin isinosource. Yun lamang po yung nakahiwalay. Siguro nga po maganda pagkadadagdagan yung aming budget para doon.

segments.speaker: NCMB OIC-Executive Director IV Teresita E. Audea
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Secretary. Dagdagan mo lang yung education na P355 per thousand per month.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: thank you also for the, yung you already mentioned.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: Yung sunod naman, Mr. Secretary, amid all our debates regarding wage order number 27, let us be reminded, maraming gutom.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: And of course, yung minimum wage, nandito naman si Executive Director MWPC. Maraming gutom.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: And survival wages talaga. And already, I will not, you know, in support of kamanggagawa party list kong ELI.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: So, there is a, you know, you cited a Supreme Court that is already a, there is already a writ issue there.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: so now we can talk to Joyce Manungsong, yung sa RTC.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: We could have, you know, if all of this, may appeal from TUCP is that hanapin nating solusyon.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: And if I read it na lang, para matapos tayo.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: The assailed order should not restrain respondents in implementing the wage order

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: in absence of valid and duly issued writ of preliminary injunction.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: Sabi lang dito, it bears stressing that the assailed order merely granted the application of a WPI.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: However, it did not bring the writ into existence.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: Rules of Court provides the issuance of writ is expressly relies on the fulfillment of certain conditions.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: There is a, if I may mistake, a suspensive condition.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: Do not like to stand on, importante na magbayad siya ng bond.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: So, there is certain condition which is the bond in this particular, in this moment.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: This means that the order granting the P.I. or preliminary injunction,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: does not, standing alone, operate as a writ itself.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: The injunctive relief becomes legally operational only upon the fulfillment of the condition,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: followed by the formal issuance of the corresponding writ.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: Until these mandatory steps are fully satisfied,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: the assailed order produces no binding injunctive effect.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: Pagtatalo tayo dito, Mr. Secretary, your thoughts because I'm losing time.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: Kasi talaga, there's no writ to talk about.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: This is the opinion of the OSG.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Idadagdag ko po, yun pong nakalagay sa pleading ng OSG,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: ay meron din pong nanggaling sa DOLE.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Yun po ay bago din raft, in raft, finalized, bago finile,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: ay nag-uusap po ang DOLE at kung ano yung mga dapat tamang ilaman dyan.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Kaya maulanggalang na sa Office of the Solicitor General,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: yung pong sila po yung nag-finalize niya pero malaki rin po ang inputs ng DOLE.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: So lahat po nang sinabi dyan ay sumang-ayon kami at sumang-ayon sila.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Yan po ay joint, collaborative endeavor between our legal,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: nandun pa po si Yusek Mosquera noon, na ngayon ay lumipat na sa kataas-taasang hukuman.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: So yan po ay aming final...

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Precisely pressure, compel, hindi ko po kilala yung nabanggit niyong kilala ko lang sa pangalan,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: yung judge, to pressure the judge to come up, come out with that appropriate resolution,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: dissolving any existing injunction, and proceed with the eventual implementation of Wage Order No. 27.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Mindful, Your Honor, of another case which we never cited in that motion,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: which is entitled Active Wood Products versus Intermediate Appellate Court.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: This was issued in 1990, so this is a long-standing jurisprudence, Your Honor,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: wherein the Supreme Court rejected the argument,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: that the injunction or any order could simply be disregarded because the bond has not yet been filed.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: It held that the order plainly intended the acts sought to be stopped must be stopped by the court.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: It should not be a unilateral action on the part of, again, I reiterate, the parties' litigants.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Kaya nga po, Your Honor, nagkatulungan po ang OSG.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: At ang DOLE, kung paano balangkasin yung naturang pleading para mapabilis po.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: At ito pong huling finile, itong September 3 motion to resolve,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: ay magkausap din po ang DOLE at ang OSG kung ano yung tenor,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: kung ano yung nilalamanan dapat i-file para madaling ma-resolve ba na yung naturang usapin, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: This morning, I thank you for your visit.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: And then, moving forward na lang tayo, let's find ways na ma-resolve ito.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: And then, with an assurance from you that there's no such thing as NCR Wage Order No. 28?

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Your Honor, kasama po sa trabaho ng mga wage boards, ang humanap din siguro ng paraan.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Subalit ang sinisigurado ko pong risulta dito, kung anuman ang mangyayari,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Ang ating mga manggagawa na tamang dagdag o mento, ay kanilang matatanggap ngayong taong ito.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Hindi ko masabi kung anong buwan ngayong taon ito.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Lalong-lalo na po yung first tranche.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Dapat po matanggap na yan sa lalong madaling panahon.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Ang kinakabahan ko po, Your Honor, kanina, nabanggit ko sa inyo,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: meron na namang po ang Court of Appeals na ifinile dito po ng Isantiga.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: This is very, it's complicating the issue.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: Now, if you issue a Wage Order No. 28 na hindi pa yung tapos 27,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: you know, ako I'll be inclined, I'll join Mr. Eli here to defer.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: Talo naman kami, pero let's, as I said, let's move forward.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Raymond Democrito C. Mendoza
segments.text: Let's talk on how are we going to find ways, finding that solution, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: In fact, we wrote a separate letter to the Speaker of the House, the members of...

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: And committees and pretty soon with the Senate President himself.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: So, naniniwala po kami na kailangan ito. Ano lang naman po?

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: One, to address the needs of the workers in Labor Attorney's Office para may free legal assistance sila nationwide to hire 64 lawyers.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Para magkaroon tayo ng isang academy na magte-training sa mga mediators, conciliators, labor arbiters, etc., etc.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: And continuing education na rin po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Ito yung gap na nakita nyo sa loob ng tatlong buwan magmula nung itinalaga kayo na sekretary ng DOLE.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Ito yung gap na gusto nyong punan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Yung training sa mga quasi-judicial officers. Tama po ba?

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: At marami pa po rin tayong...

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Kagaya po ang nasabi ko kanina, siguro ad hoc na lang po yun.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Tatag po tayo ng isang Maritime Labor Affairs Office para naman po mag-comply sa International Labor Organization.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: At para matulungan din yung ating mga tripulante.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Hindi lang yung nasa laot kung hindi yung mga nagsisiman pa rito, etc., etc.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Yung sa hinihingi nyo po na pondo para sa NALJ na lang para may click.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Na 50 million. Ano po yung batayan o basis ng 50 million?

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Meron po kaming makapal na dokumento rito para dun sa 83 pages po ito.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Para dun lang po to operationalize this proposal, it would require a retooling of the existing ILS.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: For studies, it would require the creation of a governing board.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: It would require the creation of an office of a chancellor, a better library and research development program,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: as well as pursue the two pillars I mentioned a while ago, labor justice, education, professional formation.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: And then, pillar two is labor justice policy, research and knowledge development,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: which is the focus of the ILS.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Kung makikita nyo po, your honor, napakagaling ng Bureau of Internal Revenue,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: yung kanilang mga issuances, regulations, number, blah, ganun po.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Sa amin po, medyo nalilito na rin ako na dun sa numbering pa lang.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: So, we hope to codify all of this.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: So, parang silang merong database sa mga precedents na pwedeng pagbatayan

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: para consistent po yung paglabas sa mga desisyon at saka mga rulings,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: dahil meron silang parang, pwede silang sumangguni dun sa database na yun.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Gusto rin namin po magkaroon ng ISCRA para sa NLRC.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Gusto rin namin magkaroon ng ISCRA para sa mga labor arbiters.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Ngayon po, sa proposed NEP for 2027, binanggit po ni Undersecretary kanina na tumaas po yung budget para sa ILS.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Now, binanggit po yung budget para sa ILS.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: So, binanggit po yung NALJ. Yan po ang papalit sa ILS.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Yung karagdagang pondo na mapupunta sa, at yung pondong nilaan para sa ILS, I would assume,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: the NALJ will take over. Tama po ba?

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Correct. But the present increase in the NEP of the ILS is just for the ILS per se.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Hindi pa po nakapatong dun yung NALJ because NALJ would require,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: itong 50 million na ito, ma-itemize naman po ito, would require the additional facilities such as a digital library

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: and perhaps a modest courtroom, parang moot court, na kung saan pwedeng mag-practice yung mga nag-a-apply na NLRC commissioner or labor arbiters.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Ganon din po yung mga estudyante nating fourth year sa law school.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Yung detalye po na yan, yung hawak nyo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Kasi yan po yung parang justification for the 50 million for the NALJ.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Yes, we can submit this, Your Honor, today.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Opo. Although this is my copy, kung tatanggapin nyo po, may mga notes, notes lang ako. May mga sulat lang ako eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: And then, pangalawa po, same request for the Labor Attorney's Office, 75 million, some justification for, the justification for that, the computation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Dahil doon po sa Labor Attorney's Office yung sinasabi nyo, kailangan ng 64 na labor arbiters, 32 legal officers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Pag nakikita po akong ganyang eksaktong detalye, ang tanong ko, bakit ganun na numero?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: So, kung meron po kayong justification, kung maaari po isumiti sa committee.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Ito po yan, Your Honor. Ibibigay ko na po ngayon yung, meron naman kaming digital file nito, pero marami na po akong sulat-sulat dito.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Kung tatanggapin nyo po ito, eh, ibibigay ko po. Wala po ako ditong mga drawing-drawing, Your Honor. Malinis po ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Ngayon, yung ano po, yung sa Labor Attorney's Office, ang pagkakalam ko po, yung Public Attorney's Office, yan na po yung mandato eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Natulungan yung mga indigent litigants. Hindi po sapat yung trabaho na ginagawa ng pao na kinakailangan po ng Labor Attorney's Office?

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Naipasa ko na eh. Nangirapan na akong kabulin si...

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Meron po kaming datos doon na yung workload ng PAO ay halos nakatutok sa mga criminal cases sa probinsya.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: May mga civil cases din at kakaunti po ang nabibigyan ng konsiderasyon sa mga labor arbiters.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Lalong-lalo na yung mga nakabase po sa Metro Manila at yung mga regional centers natin.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: So, meron po ditong justification, yung percentage ng...

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: trabaho ng Public Attorney's Office patungkol po doon sa kanilang workload.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Na ang bulk po ay yung talagang pampiskal.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Ang workload po ay yung mga pang-RTC.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: So, dito po sa arbitration, sa conciliation, ay halos wala po.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Lalong-lalo na po sa pangkaraniwang kasong dinudulog po sa amin.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Yung po ang nagsulong para sa tanggapan na itulak itong mungkahing ito.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: At nandun po lahat ng data na hindi ko na po masight ngayon kasi napilitan akong iabot na kay Chairman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: Actually, Mr. Secretary, I was instructing the Secretariat na if amenable naman si Rep. Tony Roman

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: after the once-a-day copies have been furnished, we'll furnish a copy to Rep. Tony Roman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Kung dalawang programa na gusto nyo na karagdaga na pondo, yung NALJ at at yung Legal Labor Attorney's Office,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Kailangan package deal na magkasama o may ding paghiwalay yan?

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Magkahiwalay po yan, but they work together.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: And it's very timely, Your Honor, kasi po ngayon darating na 2027,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: ang Pilipinas po ang mamumuno ng International Labor Council sa ILO sa Geneva.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: So, nais po nating ipakita sa ibang bansa na meron tayong ganitong mga tanggapan

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: na talagang tumutugon sa pangangailangan ng ating manggagawa,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: including that National Academy for Labor Justice, which is a first.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Mga kabataang Pilipino na nag-aaral ng abugasya, first year, second year,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: hindi pa nila alam pag sila ay...

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Kasi pagkakaiba po sa medical school, first year, second year,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: alam mo na kung ikaw ay magiging surgeon kung gusto mong mag-specialize.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: So, ito po ay magbubukas ng pinto para sa mga law students na ay maganda pala ang labor justice.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: O gaya ngayon, pag-graduate mo ng law school, parang general practitioner ka na sa medisina, ganun din.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: So, natatangi po ito, hindi sa pagbubuhat ng sariling bangko, kasi itong dalawang ito, first time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: May napapansin ko, madalang po ipa nagtatanong sa kanya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Yung nakita niyo po yung Neptune for 2027, meron mo bang aspeto doon?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Na napailing kayo at halos maluha.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: We made a request for more positions, particularly in the field, to help us roll out and implement our programs with greater efficiency.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: We also made a greater request, sir, for capital outlay.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Pero yung talagang naluluha ako, siguro, ay ang pagliit po ng aming scholarship budget.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Which is also how I ended my presentation earlier, with a request that at the very least, in order to ensure that the expansion of the education reform and its implementation in accordance with the NAD plan,

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: at the very least sana, maging equal sa GAA ng 2026, ang budget po ng test.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Notice, ang pinakamalaki pong hiningi namin sa aming, hindi ho kasi wish list yun eh, kagaya ng sinabi ni Kong Jolo kanina,

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: eh yung wish list ho namin eh, an additional 20 billion na marahil naman eh hindi mabibigay, no.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Nasabi na ho sa amin ni Kong Jila yan.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: But the biggest portion, sir, is actually in the universal access to quality tertiary education.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: We are requesting an additional 2.4 billion for our diploma programs nationwide,

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: so that as we expand towards higher level training with greater skill and greater productivity,

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: ay masuportahan din po namin ng budget namin ang kapipirima lang po na amendment to the UACTA law last week.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: So the request is really to make sure that at the very least,

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: our budget for 2027 is more or less equivalent,

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: to our 2026, in particular with regards to our scholarship slots,

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: para ho dumami, imbis na kumonte, ang matulungan ng TESDA in terms of its programs, no, for learning and training.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Pero kung mabigyan niyo po kami ng capital outlay, marami po kami pangangailangan na nakalagay na po dyan.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: I would also like to flag to the committee as a former congressman na lang.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Said, marami pong mga past legislation or legislation that has been passed into law

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: to create local government training centers under TESDA which has not been funded by the DBM consistently.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: So yun lang naman po ang aming mga totohanang wish list na for sure hindi po mabibigay kasi madami pagkahanapan.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: But at the very least, sir, an additional...

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: An additional 5.3 or 5.4 billion po to make sure that our scholarship budget at least is equivalent to this year.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Para hindi naman ho mag-shrink even as we are doing so well to increase the demand and the awareness, no, of the impact of TECVOC training nationwide.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Binagay niyo po 5.3 billion. Kanina may binagay kayo na 2.4 billion. Medyo naguluhan ako.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Yung 2.4 billion na binagay kayo kanina. Ito'y parang pagpapatuloy nung sa scholarships, tama po ba?

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Ito po ang pagpapatuloy natin sa diploma programs.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: So these are the 2 to 3 year higher level NC3 to NC5 programs taught by TESDA or TESDA institutions

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: that are being ladderized into bachelor's degrees of CHED.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: So as the one education system converges with greater efficiency,

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: for the benefit of better human development in the country,

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: ang prediction ho namin ay it will widen and it will be more expansive.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: So to reduce budget at this point might freeze the reforms in track and not be able to get us to implement the NACP plan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Sir, would it be possible to submit a sort of a breakdown of your additional asks?

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: So it's actually part of the presentation that was handed to the committee this morning.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: Rep Tony, we already have the breakdown of the...

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: When the good secretary presented earlier, it was the climax of his presentation because it was very, very important to the department.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: So I will instruct the secretary to furnish you a copy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: The presentation was short and sweet and so the climax passed without my noticing it.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: I don't want the secretary to tear up.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: So I'm in support of the increase in budget of TESDA as well as DOLE.

segments.text: We move back to the minority.

segments.text: Magandang hapon po sa puong DOLE at TESDA this afternoon.

segments.text: Nandito rin po ang aking kaibigan na is kumbatiin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Mr. Chair, before I begin, I would like to congratulate Secretary Francis Tolentino on his appointment to DOLE.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Sekretary, having served in the Senate, you come to DOLE with a deep understanding of legislation, government processes, and the concerns of our workers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Although you have been with the department for a few months only,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: we have already seen some encouraging directions,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: particularly your focus on labor justice, assistance to workers, and improving the delivery of DOLE programs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Marami pong kailangan ayusin sa DOLE,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: at marami sa mga problema ang tatanungin namin ngayon ay naabutan lamang ninyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: with your experience in the Senate and now your leadership of the department,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: I am confident that you can address these long-standing implementation issues.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And make sure that the funds of Congress, that the funds Congress provides actually reach our workers.

segments.text: We hope to understand where the bottlenecks are, what support DOLE needs,

segments.text: and how Congress can help make these programs work better for our workers.

segments.text: Your Honor, kanina po ay nagbigay ng hiling yung aming Undersecretary.

segments.text: I think that the document would...

segments.text: Speak for itself kung ilan yung nilalaman noon.

segments.text: And if I can defer to the good undersecretary.

segments.text: Kung sa 2027 po, BBM sa NEP po,

segments.text: Kung ilan ang dapat beneficiaries na

segments.speaker: DOLE Undersecretary Warren M. Miclat
segments.text: with the permission of the secretary,

segments.speaker: DOLE Undersecretary Warren M. Miclat
segments.text: mga million na po ang aming target po.

segments.text: So depende na po sa number of days na work po,

segments.text: kung ganung katagal itong kabahagat na ito.

segments.text: Hindi po natin, hindi naman natin na predict, Your Honor,

segments.text: Akala ko, contain lang sa Pamplona,

segments.text: So yung mga ganung variables po,

segments.text: Ang sinasabi po siguro ni Undersecretary

segments.text: is we need to have that

segments.text: Yung mga ganun po ay hindi namin

segments.text: Kung kaya nga po yung aming apila

segments.text: ay mabigyan kami ng sapat na

segments.text: Sa area-based demand-driven po namin, malinaw po na meron pong more job openings, no?

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: In fact, then we have unemployed Filipinos, which really suggests that the job openings that DOLE itself actually puts together

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: in the peso, in the public employment service offices,

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: that information doesn't reach the right people who might be the right fit for those jobs.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: So anything that we can do to improve that and intensify

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: that link, the faster we can address unemployment, at least in terms of employment per se.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: The second is, of course, nabanggit rin ni Yusek Torres, is the job skills mismatching with regards to DepEd, TESDA, and CHED

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: to make sure that our youth actually have the right skills for the kind of jobs that are available to them.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: So, nandyan nga ang JobStart, meron pong fieldjobs.net, at ang nabanggit po ni Secretary Tolentino kanina is that TESDA put together the skills passport

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: precisely to provide a digital platform to help create these linkages and address information asymmetry para at least hindi po information ang kulang.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: So that JobStart, fieldjobs.net, and so on.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: At the least, TVET graduates can have access online in real time to the job openings that are available.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: These are all being designed to make sure that our supply and our demand meet together.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: So, ang ano na lang dyan, ma'am, is how effectively, how intensively, no, both Dole and TESDA can in fact roll out this program with the kind of urgency that we need.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: The other piece that should be clear is that we need to make sure that demand side is commensurate.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: So, Bureau of Investment naman po yan because we need to make sure that industry opens up and has as much job openings that are of decent work

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: and of the decent scale of quality of salaries and so on, that again, bahagi po yan sa macroeconomic slowdown ng...

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: So, kanina, nagtanong po si kong Robert tungkol po sa area-based demand-driven approach ng prioritization ng TESDA.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: No, what we try to do is to prioritize at least government funds to those sectors that have the most demand or most emerging job openings.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: So, nandyan po, kagaya ng kanina pang pinag-uusapan ng ICT, ang AI, nandyan po ang actually maritime tourism and services.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Nandyan po ang semiconductors and advanced manufacturing.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: All of these are sectors that are being prioritized because we know that the jobs are actually available

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: and we need to make sure that our workforce is appropriately skilled for the jobs that actually exist.
