segments.text: Anything else, Sec, aside from the additional allocation for TUPAD

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: and for the Labor Attorney's Office on the side of DOLE?

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: We already have a copy of the folder.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Here it is, it's already up to you, your additional folder.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Your Honors, there are pending requests with...

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: This got the concurrence of the Department...

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Sa darating puntaon, as I've mentioned earlier, early this afternoon,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: tayo po ang mamumuno ng International Labour Council ng ILO sa Geneva.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Simula po noon nawala yung puder sa Department of Employment

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: at napunta sa Department of Migrant Workers iyong mga labor attach?s.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: sa base sa mga liham na pinadala namin sa DBM,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: na magkaroon man lang tayo ng kahit isang desk

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: na puwedeng magpagawa ng calling card na labor attach? sa Geneva.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Ganon din po sa Jakarta, kung saan tayo merong ASEAN Secretariat.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: At sa Washington, D.C., yung po yung tatlong hinihiling namin,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: hindi kalakihan, umaabot lang po ito sa aming pananaw,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: 137 milyon sa tatlong tao na ipoposte sa naturang tatlong lugar

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: to coordinate labor policy issues including maritime conventions among others

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: na sa ngayon po ay meron tayong void.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Isang desk lang po ang dadalin doon, isang tao,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: na meron naman sigurong subsistence allowance.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: sa ambasador, doon na lang kahit matulog sa embahada,

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: bigyan na lang ng kwarto doon.

segments.speaker: DOLE Secretary Francis N. Tolentino
segments.text: Yun lamang po, Madam Cherang Karagdagan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: I don't know if the second folder already contained the ILO request.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So we'll just wait for those, Sec.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: If ever, if you may please give it to us by 12 noon tomorrow,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: given that we're targeting to convene the BARC at the soonest possible time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: just so we can have all of these under deliberation, po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you very much, po, Sec. Tolentino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Sec Kiko, I will also give the floor to you po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: I have here, as shared with me by Kong Gila, an additional 4.7 billion request.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Opo, it's 5.3 billion with these items, po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, essentially, po, they described it as yung mga na-restore po natin last year.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: May dalawang dagdag po sa baba.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Yeah, actually, Sec, I was gonna ask about that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Zero siya, totally, in the NEP.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Because it's a new proposal, no?

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: To make sure, ma'am, that we have the aligned senior high school teachers

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: for the effectivity of the rollout for grade 12 in this coming year.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Not this school year, but the following school year

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: This is designed to make sure that the teachers within DepEd

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: or within senior high school in general

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: have the appropriate NCs as well as the TVET learning

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: so that they can, in fact, be appropriately assessed.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Because one of the major obstacles, ma'am, in the senior high school assessment

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: has been, in fact, that there are insufficient DepEd

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: or senior high school teachers with the appropriate training

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: So this is meant to cure that, no?

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: And the second, ma'am, is an extension, again,

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: to include barangay health workers and nutrition scholars

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: for the expansion of the early childhood care and development initiative.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: So in those two cases, ma'am, it's meant to help respond, in fact,

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: to the EDCOM findings and to the NAP plan.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: The request of 5.3 is really just to get us back to the GAA level

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Rather than have a shrinkage, if you like,

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: of the number of learners that we would,

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: be able to serve in accordance, again,

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: with the initiatives we agreed to in the NAP plan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you very much, po, Sekiko.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: If I may ask, po, these two, the last two items,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: were these at all included in the proposal to DBM?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Or sobrang bago po siya na hindi na siya nasama?

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: We extracted them when we were asked to prioritize

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: what was not given in the Tier 2.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: If I may request din, po, by 12 noon tomorrow,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: kasa lang po, kailangan po namin ma-collate

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: lahat po ng mga requests for institutional amendments

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: from all of the different agencies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So we have time po to deliberate on the side of the BARC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: I think those are the, I just wanted to clarify those, po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Given that there are no other interpolators,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Before we solicit the necessary motion for Dole and TESDA,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: we would first like to take this opportunity again

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: the budget sponsors for Dole and TESDA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you so much, Vice Chair Romel Angara

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: I'd also like to thank, of course,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: and to the Dole and TESDA family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you for working with us over the last eight hours

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: to respond to all the queries our colleagues have.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: These are really helpful for us to be able to move forward

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: in terms of refining the budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Maraming maraming salamat po. Thank you also for being our partners in delivering services to our constituents and to the different localities. I think po a lot of our colleagues have expressed their thanks. Actually po hindi po sila nagtanong, nagmanifest lang po ng pasasalamat at support at commendation po to DOLE and TESDA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you po for helping us deliver these services to our constituents. And the best way that we could thank you is to make sure you have the resources that you need moving forward in fiscal year 2027 to be able to perform your mandate and deliver services to our countrymen. So maraming maraming salamat po to our DOLE and TESDA family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: I would like to recognize Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand Hernandez.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Parang suspense yung mga mukha niyo eh.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Madam Chair, I move that the committee terminate its hearing on the proposed fiscal year 2027 budget of the Department of Labor and Employment, including its attached agencies under House Bill No. 10858. I so move.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: It has been moved and duly seconded to terminate the hearing on the proposed fiscal year 2027 budget of the Department of Labor and Employment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: It has been duly seconded. There has been no objection.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Sorry po, we have one more important motion. Hindi po tayo makaka-uwi without this next motion. My apologies po.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: I would now like once again to recognize Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand Hernandez.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Basahin mo muna. Ito na po yung culmination and termination.

segments.text: So we're just making sure we make the necessary motions.

segments.text: the Fiscal Year 2027 General Appropriations Bill.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: The Chair thanks all the members of the Committee, our distinguished colleagues in the House,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: the agencies and their resource persons,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: and the Committee Secretariat for your participation and hard work throughout these proceedings.

segments.text: And with that, I recognize Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand Hernandez.

segments.text: Madam Chair, all scheduled agency budget hearings under House Bill No. 10858 having been completed,
